title: Event registration service
context: Implement an in-memory event registration service: add an event with a capacity, register and cancel users, and list the registrations. The doc comment lists the rules; the tests check them. This is modelled on a HackerRank event registration task reported for GetYourGuide's backend interview.

points.title: Per-event map of users
points.why: A map from event id to its registrations gives direct lookup. A set per event stops a user registering twice.
points.fix: HashMap of event id to a LinkedHashSet of user ids. LinkedHashSet keeps registration order.

points.title: Check capacity and duplicates before adding
points.why: Without these checks a full event takes another user, and a repeated user is counted twice.
points.fix: Return false when the event is full or the user is already registered.

points.title: Cancel reports whether a registration was removed
points.why: The result of remove tells the caller whether the user was registered, and the seat frees up for the next user.

points.title: Unknown events fail loudly
points.why: A typo in an event id should not look like an empty event.
points.fix: One lookup helper that throws IllegalArgumentException, used by every method that takes an event id.
